info.desc: Heaven and Earth is the second studio album by American jazz saxophonist Kamasi Washington. It was released on June 22, 2018, through Young Turks Recordings. Both CD and LP versions of the album contain an extra disc called "The Choice" which is hidden within a closed part of the packaging which must be cut open to access the disc. .

podcast.body: This new album from Kamasi Washington, referred to in the transcript as "Kevin Ann Earth," is from one of the most significant living saxophonists, especially within the jazz and experimental jazz scenes. He is noted as possibly the only experimental jazz artist under 40, is highly respected in the jazz world, and has collaborated with major figures like David Bowie. This album is presented as an excellent entry point for those less familiar with jazz. "es uno de los saxofonistas más importantes que hay ahora mismo vivo y es curioso porque yo creo que debe ser el único saxofonista o artista de jazz así experimental menor de 40 años que hay."
